Section.Title: Dedicated Healing
Section.Hint: Once treated, this condition absorbs healing instead of hit points, and clears when it has taken enough.

Field.RequiredHint: HP of dedicated healing needed to clear this. 0 = off for this buff.
Field.ClearOnHealHint: No threshold: this buff switches itself off as soon as its bearer's hit points go up. Held Open By still applies.
Field.DCHint: Heal check to make it ready to absorb healing. 0 waives the check.
Field.DCHintOnHeal: Heal check before healing will close it. 0 = no check needed.
Field.BlockedByHint: Name of another buff on the same actor. While it is active this wound absorbs no healing — the arrow still in it. Leave empty for none.
Field.ReadyOnHeal: Ready — the next healing clears this
Field.ResetTooltip: Clear the treated mark and healing received.
